title: Cosmic Core
description: Create a radial gradient that starts as pure white in the center and transitions to a deep purple (0.2, 0.0, 0.4) towards the edges. The gradient should be circular, even if the screen is rectangular.
hintText: You'll need to center your UV coordinates first. Use length(uv) to get the distance from the center, and mix() with smoothstep() to create the color transition.
